notes.title: The remake update is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]What's New:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31140372/93fd1028ce491f16f011932c9548b7a3fe905cec.png[/img]

[h3]In-game:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Infinite play mode with three difficulties added.
[*] Output holders, input holders, and math operators redesigned.
[*] New animations, particle effects, lighting.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31140372/c122f23b976678e31ea69adbc595511e36e9d881.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The flow of operations is now continuous. So the flow button is removed.
[*] Operator and connection removal buttons added.
[*] New color palette.
[*] UI redesigned.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31140372/5b3e0b787e3046d56beca3b5bd6ce685554f381d.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Level info bar added. 
[*] Equation hint bar redesigned.
[*] Background music added.
[*] Tutorial redesigned.
[*] New achievements added.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31140372/1554e1df97bce54c99f6148b8c1de6320709f570.png[/img]


[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The main menu is redesigned.
[*] Achievements menu added.
[*] Mac support added.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31140372/278910cfd20f0ed7373c9252ef59ed6997df804b.png[/img]


[h3]What's Coming In The Next Update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New handcrafted levels.
[*] A new game mode where you can compete against time.
[*] Steam leaderboards.
[/list]



I've made this update after 5 years to say thank you to all of you who supported me by buying my first game on Steam. I was just starting my game development journey and it helped a ton. 


It has now become a fun little puzzle game that you can relax, play, and sharpen your mind with a nice warm coffee. I hope you will like it!

notes.title: Complete remake update is coming!
notes.notes:
After I announced that I decided to retire the Flow Handcrafted, I got a couple of messages requesting things before I remove the game.


This was my first project ever on Steam and It wasn't fulfilling for me quality-wise anymore. So I thought I should retire it if I can't support it since I am working all day on another project and couldn't find the time for it. 

But after your massages, I come to a realization that I should not abandon my first game ever and I decided to make an update with my current experience. I hope you will enjoy it and many thanks for your interest.


[b]What's coming with the update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Infinite play mode.
[*] New Achievements.
[*] Mac support.
[*] Huge graphics update.
[*] UI update.
[*] Music.
[/list]
